title: Spider dragline silk-inspired 3D printed sustainable zinc ion batteries with ultrahigh stability
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE02022D, Paper
Open Access

Hongyu Lu, Jisong Hu, Botao Jiang, Kaiqi Zhang, Zhengyu Ju, Gehong Su, Yuanyuan Gao, Zhaodan Fu, Jingxin Zhao, Bingang Xu, Guihua Yu
Inspired by spider dragline silk architecture, we developed a green and recyclable double-network zinc metal anode via multi-band UV 3D printing, enabling scalable fabrication of highly stable and recyclable zinc-ion batteries.
